name: TANGO DANCE NIGHT
description:
JOIN US FOR TANGO NIGHT
Join us for an evening of Argentine tango music, dancing, and socializing at Lou’s in Harvard Square!
Your ticket includes a free introductory tango lesson, followed by dancing for the rest of the evening with music from DJ Facha.
Whether you’re an experienced dancer or looking to try something new, everyone is welcome. No partner is required.
7:00–8:00 PM — Beginner Tango Dance Lesson
8:00–11:00 PM+ — Tango Dancing and Socializing
Admission
General Admission – $20
Includes the lesson and social dancing.
Student Admission – $15
Available at the door on the night of the event with a valid student ID.
Get Tickets
Free Parking at the Harvard Square Parking Garage at 20 Eliot Street.
Hosted by: Sam Galler (IG: @
smgaller
